MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "Partners and To Be Loved appeal because polished vocals, duets, and traditional arrangements connect with what I enjoy in Stages, A Musical Affair, and Lead With Your Heart.",
    "That's Christmas To Me feels like a natural choice because it combines the Christmas music I have chosen before with the ensemble singing I want now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "In The Lonely Hour, 25, and 1989 do not give me the same reason to listen as orchestral vocals, musical-style performances, or familiar standards; a melodic vocal album alone is not enough.",
    "Django and Jimmie and Storyteller lean too far into my occasional country interest for this visit. Eagles: The Very Best Of has familiar melodies I enjoy, but I would still choose vocal crossover first.",
    "I cannot confidently connect Oscd Ad Adele 21 with the listening experience I want, so it gives me little reason to choose it now."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My interest in expressive singers seems to have been broadened into an interest in almost any prominent vocal album, although the arrangements and style of singing matter to me.",
    "My choices of 747 and Golden seem to have been given more weight than my repeated interest in ensemble vocals, musical performances, and soundtracks."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "The connection between Stages, A Musical Affair, Amor & Pasion, and Lead With Your Heart matters: I am drawn to polished voices with a theatrical or romantic feel.",
    "My most recent choice of relaxing classical music suggests that a calm, orchestral listening experience deserves more attention alongside my vocal interests."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The choices partly recognize my taste for polished singing, but stretch it too broadly into pop and country instead of following my current interest in orchestral, ensemble, and musical-style performances."
}
